caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure standing against a plain, light beige background. The woman has pale skin with rosy cheeks and lips, and she has dark hair styled up with a small red or brown accessory on top. She is wearing a long, full-length dress with long sleeves and a modest, square neckline. The dress is predominantly light in color, including shades of beige, gray, and hints of blue and purple, and it features subtle, soft shading and folds indicating the fabric. There is a slightly darker sash or band around her waist. The cuffs and lower hem of the dress are accentuated with faint lines, suggesting trim or ruffles. Her hands, with visible fingers, are positioned at her sides, and the feet are mostly obscured by the dress, but a small part of the shoes in dark color can be seen peeking out at the bottom. The entire composition is centered, with the figure occupying most of the vertical space on the otherwise unembellished background.
